CustomField.description: Required. Drives visibility of downstream fields (`CheckDate` for check gifts; `FQS_Fair_Market_Value_Amount__c` for `In-Kind`). On pledge / recurring payments, inherits from the parent schedule.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How this gift was paid. Drives visibility of Check Date, Fair Market Value (in-kind), and other payment-specific fields. Inherits from the parent schedule on pledge payments.
